//: Making (12 §10.7; 16 §8): what the character could make here, by hand and at each station within a step, with what each takes and what of it is at hand, what it gives, and why one cannot be started. Recipes are content of other mods, and so is the action that works one: this mod names `make` bare, which means whichever loaded mod's action of that name comes first in order of id (the `core` mod's takes `recipe` and `station`). What is listed is the simulation's: `view.recipe_options`, worked out from what the character believes is at hand. Choosing one starts the work; the work goes on until it is done or the character does something else, and what was done is kept where it was made.
title: Make

list.item: {if it.available then it.name else ''}<dim>{if it.available then '' else it.name}</>  {it.where}{if it.resumes then ', under way' else ''}: {it.takes} gives {it.gives}<dim>{if it.available then '' else ': '}{if it.available then '' else it.why}</>
list.empty: There is nothing you know how to make here.
list.tip: Enter starts the work; a greyed one says why it cannot.

tooltip.value: Up and Down choose, Enter makes it, Esc goes back.
